verdict.rationale: AMD's Ryzen AI Software stack documents ONNX Runtime with the Vitis AI EP for the NPU, the DirectML EP for the iGPU, OGA NPU-only and hybrid modes, llama.cpp for GPU-only acceleration, and whisper.cpp NPU offload. Community hands-on reports confirm llama.cpp running large models on Strix Halo (Framework Desktop 128GB). Missing for 10: a support matrix that explicitly names the Max+ 395 SKU (the docs refer to Ryzen AI and AI 300 Series generally), and documentation of a CPU-specific runtime path.

support.subject: As a developer, mainstream local-AI runtimes target this silicon — llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or the vendor's own AI software stack document support for its CPU, GPU, or NPU

citations.quote: run them directly on laptops powered by Ryzen AI using ONNX Runtime and the Vitis™ AI Execution Provider (EP)
NPU-only and hybrid execution modes, which utilize both the NPU and integrated GPU (iGPU), are supported by ONNXRuntime GenAI (OGA). GPU-only acceleration is enabled through llama.cpp.
the ONNX Runtime DirectML EP (`DmlExecutionProvider`) is used to run the model on the AMD Ryzen AI GPU
On AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series systems, Whisper can fully offload the encoder to the NPU
